Description.Name: Delilah Anne
Description.Details: A former MechWarrior of the Magistracy Armed Forces, Delilah Anne was expelled after a court martial found her guilty of embezzlement and other financial charges. After she being dishonorably discharged, Anne kept her criminal path and joined the pirate group Satan's Kittens until she was captured by mercenaries in the Deep Periphery. On a personal note, Delilah's callsign is 'Queen of Spades' because it is one of the nicknames given to Natasha Kerensky, the dazzling Wolf's Dragoons officer who has become an inspiration for dozens of pilots, who will even go and adopt Kerensky's appearance, like Delilah does.
